descriptions.look_at_obj_in_light: Procedure for examining an object under a light.
descriptions.pick_and_place: Procedure for picking up one object and putting it somewhere.
descriptions.pick_clean_then_place: Procedure for cleaning an object and then putting it somewhere.
descriptions.pick_cool_then_place: Procedure for cooling an object and then putting it somewhere.
descriptions.pick_heat_then_place: Procedure for heating an object and then putting it somewhere.
descriptions.pick_two_obj_and_place: Procedure for picking up two objects and putting them somewhere.

descriptions.look_at_obj_in_light: Use when the task says to look at, examine, or inspect an object under a desklamp or floorlamp (e.g. "look at the alarmclock under the desklamp"). Take the object, then turn on the lamp.
descriptions.pick_and_place: Use for a plain single-object move: "put a mug on the desk", "put some soap in the cabinet". Use only when the task has no heat/cool/clean step, no lamp, and no "two".
descriptions.pick_clean_then_place: Use when the task says to put a CLEAN object somewhere (e.g. "put a clean plate in the cabinet"). Wash it at the sinkbasin, then place it.
descriptions.pick_cool_then_place: Use when the task says to put a COLD, cooled, or chilled object somewhere (e.g. "put a cold apple on the table"). Cool it in the fridge, then place it.
descriptions.pick_heat_then_place: Use when the task says to put a HOT, heated, or warm object somewhere (e.g. "put a hot potato on the countertop"). Heat it in the microwave, then place it.
descriptions.pick_two_obj_and_place: Use when the task asks for TWO of an object (e.g. "put two pillows on the sofa", "find two cds and put them in the drawer"). Find and place both, one at a time.

descriptions.look_at_obj_in_light: Load for tasks like "look at X under the desklamp" or "examine X with the floorlamp": find the object, take it, and turn on the lamp. Use whenever a lamp is in the task.
descriptions.pick_and_place: Load for simple tasks "put a X in/on Y" with one object and no hot/cold/clean wording, no lamp, and no "two". Take the object and place it at the destination.
descriptions.pick_clean_then_place: Load when the task says "clean X" and then put it somewhere (e.g. "put a clean plate in the cabinet"). Take the object, wash it at the sinkbasin, then place it.
descriptions.pick_cool_then_place: Load when the task says "cool X", "cold X", or "chilled X" and then put it somewhere (e.g. "put a cool apple on the table"). Take the object, cool it in the fridge, then place it.
descriptions.pick_heat_then_place: Load when the task says "heat X", "hot X", or "warm X" and then put it somewhere (e.g. "put a hot potato on the countertop"). Take the object, heat it in the microwave, then place it.
descriptions.pick_two_obj_and_place: Load when the task says "two" of an object, e.g. "put two pillows on the sofa" or "put two cds in the drawer". Find and place two separate objects of the same kind, one at a time.

descriptions.look_at_obj_in_light: ALWAYS load for tasks containing 'look at' / 'examine' / 'inspect' an object 'under' or 'with' a desklamp or floorlamp. Take the object, then turn on the lamp.
descriptions.pick_and_place: Load for a plain 'put a X in/on Y' task with ONE object and no clean/hot/cool/heat wording, no lamp, and no 'two'. Take the object and place it.
descriptions.pick_clean_then_place: Load when the task says 'clean X' (e.g. 'put a clean plate in the cabinet'). Take the object, clean it at the sinkbasin, then place it.
descriptions.pick_cool_then_place: Load when the task says 'cool', 'cold' or 'chilled' (e.g. 'put a cool apple on the table'). Take the object, cool it in the fridge, then place it.
descriptions.pick_heat_then_place: Load when the task says 'hot', 'heat' or 'warm' (e.g. 'put a hot potato on the countertop'). Take the object, heat it in the microwave, then place it.
descriptions.pick_two_obj_and_place: Load when the task contains 'two' of an object (e.g. 'put two pillows on the sofa', 'put two cds in the drawer'). Find and place two objects of the same kind, one at a time.

descriptions.look_at_obj_in_light: ALWAYS load first for any task with 'look at', 'examine', 'inspect' an object 'under'/'in light of'/'with' a desklamp or floorlamp. Take the object, then use the lamp.
descriptions.pick_and_place: ALWAYS load for a plain 'put a X in/on Y' or 'put some X on Y' task with ONE object and no clean/hot/cool/heat wording, no lamp, no 'two'. Find, take, and place it.
descriptions.pick_clean_then_place: ALWAYS load when the task says 'clean' (e.g. 'put a clean plate in the cabinet', 'clean X and put it in Y'). Take the object, clean it at the sinkbasin, then place it.
descriptions.pick_cool_then_place: ALWAYS load when the task says 'cool', 'cold', 'chilled' (e.g. 'put a cool apple on the table', 'cool X and put it in Y'). Take the object, cool it in the fridge, then place it.
descriptions.pick_heat_then_place: ALWAYS load when the task says 'hot', 'heat', 'warm', 'cook' (e.g. 'put a hot potato on the countertop', 'heat X and put it in Y'). Take the object, heat it in the microwave, then place it.
descriptions.pick_two_obj_and_place: ALWAYS load when the task contains 'two' of an object (e.g. 'put two pillows on the sofa', 'find two cds and put them in the drawer'). Find and place two objects of the same kind, one at a time.

descriptions.look_at_obj_in_light: MUST load before acting whenever the task says 'look at', 'examine', 'inspect' or 'find' an object 'under'/'in'/'with' a desklamp or floorlamp. Any task mentioning a lamp. Take the object, go to the lamp, use it.
descriptions.pick_and_place: MUST load before acting for a basic 'put a X in/on Y' or 'put some X on/in Y' task (one object, e.g. 'put a mug on the desk'). Load whenever the task has no clean/hot/cool/heat word, no lamp, and no 'two'. Find, take, place.
descriptions.pick_clean_then_place: MUST load before acting whenever the task says 'clean', 'wash' or 'rinse' (e.g. 'put a clean plate in the cabinet', 'clean X and put it in Y'). Take the object, clean it at the sinkbasin, then place it.
descriptions.pick_cool_then_place: MUST load before acting whenever the task says 'cool', 'cold', 'chilled' or 'refrigerate' (e.g. 'put a cool apple on the table', 'cool X and put it in Y'). Take the object, cool it with the fridge, then place it.
descriptions.pick_heat_then_place: MUST load before acting whenever the task says 'hot', 'heat', 'warm' or 'cook' (e.g. 'put a hot potato on the countertop', 'heat X and put it in Y'). Take the object, heat it in the microwave, then place it.
descriptions.pick_two_obj_and_place: MUST load before acting whenever the task has 'two' of something or a plural count (e.g. 'put two pillows on the sofa', 'find two cds and put them in the drawer'). Find and place two objects of the same kind, one at a time.

descriptions.look_at_obj_in_light: MUST load FIRST, before any action, for any task that mentions a desklamp or floorlamp, or says 'look at', 'examine', 'inspect' or 'find' an object 'under'/'in'/'with' a lamp. Take the object, go to the lamp, use it.
descriptions.pick_and_place: MUST load FIRST, before any action, for every basic 'put a X in/on Y' or 'put some X on/in Y' task with one object (e.g. 'put a mug on the desk', 'put some soap in the cabinet'). Load whenever the task has no clean/hot/cool/heat/wash/warm/cold word, no lamp, and no 'two'. Find, take, place.
descriptions.pick_clean_then_place: MUST load FIRST, before any action, whenever the task says 'clean', 'wash', 'rinse' or 'cleaned' (e.g. 'put a clean plate in the cabinet', 'clean X and put it in Y'). Take the object, clean it at the sinkbasin, then place it.
descriptions.pick_cool_then_place: MUST load FIRST, before any action, whenever the task says 'cool', 'cold', 'chilled', 'chill' or 'refrigerate' (e.g. 'put a cool apple on the table', 'cool X and put it in Y'). Take the object, cool it with the fridge, then place it.
descriptions.pick_heat_then_place: MUST load FIRST, before any action, whenever the task says 'hot', 'heat', 'heated', 'warm' or 'cook' (e.g. 'put a hot potato on the countertop', 'heat X and put it in Y'). Take the object, heat it in the microwave, then place it.
descriptions.pick_two_obj_and_place: MUST load FIRST, before any action, whenever the task has 'two' of something, a plural object, or a count of 2 (e.g. 'put two pillows on the sofa', 'find two cds and put them in the drawer', 'put two soapbars in the cabinet'). Find and place two objects of the same kind, one at a time.
